scope: Attended RAM diagnostic with manual firmware stop selected before unplugging and entering s2idle
operator_report: Charger attached with the device asleep. The display stayed off until the operator pressed power after about 30 seconds.
limitations: Firmware log delivery time follows wake. The operator report places the cable insertion during s2idle.
Host register sampling stopped during suspend. The available log and first post-resume reading cannot exclude a brief enable pulse during sleep.
The stop was selected before suspend. Automatic threshold crossing during sleep remains untested.
